Paragraph: "By whom you are bewildered at heart and running away, oh, the best monkey Sugreeva, I do not see that cruel-looking, cruel Vali here..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Visual hallucination/projection of fear in the absence of the actual threat.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuma explicitly states his empirical observation: Vali is not present.
Outcome/Resolution: He directly challenges Sugreeva's threat-perception hallucination with objective facts.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Pratyaksha-Pramana (Direct sensory proof dispelling illusory fears)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Direct observation (Pratyaksha) dispels illusory phantoms created by mind-based fear.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Fact-checking mental projections: relying on immediate visual evidence to counter catastrophic assumptions.
